data.gender_notes: Baqiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-q-y', meaning to remain or persist. The name Baqiya carries the profound spiritual significance of one who endures and remains steadfast in their faith. The name Baqiya carries the meaning “Everlasting, Perpetual” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baqiya usually hope their child will grow to embody everlasting, perpetual and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes steadfastness and perseverance in faith.
